# Mission backdrop

`ascent.jpg` is the official VALORANT Ascent map splash art, distributed by
[Valorant-API](https://valorant-api.com/v1/maps) at
https://media.valorant-api.com/maps/7eaecc1b-4337-bbf6-6ab9-04b8f06b3319/splash.png.
Downloaded on 2026-10-22 and converted to an optimized JPEG at 1920×1080.
Artwork belongs to Riot Games. Its use follows the same hackathon authorization
documented for the project's existing official map assets.
